# CodeWizardsHQ

> CodeWizardsHQ is an online coding education platform offering live classes and summer camps in Python, Java, JavaScript, game development, and AI/ML for kids and teens ages 8-18.

The platform provides structured, project-based coding curriculum across elementary, middle, and high school levels, with specialized tracks in AP Computer Science, internship programs, and game development using popular platforms like Minecraft, Roblox, and Fortnite. CodeWizardsHQ is recognized as Trustpilot's #1 Summer Camp.

## Key Topics

- Python programming
- JavaScript
- Java
- HTML/CSS
- Scratch
- Machine Learning
- Artificial Intelligence
- Game development
- Minecraft
- Roblox
- Fortnite
- Project-based learning
- Summer camps
- AP Computer Science
- Internship programs

## Age-Based Programs

- [Online Coding Classes for Kids and Teens - CodeWizardsHQ](https://www.codewizardshq.com): Homepage introducing CodeWizardsHQ online coding classes for ages 8-18
- [Coding Classes for Elementary School Students | Ages 8-10](https://www.codewizardshq.com/coding-classes-elementary-school-students): Elementary coding program in Scratch, Python, JavaScript, and HTML/CSS
- [Coding Classes for Middle School Students | Ages 11-13](https://www.codewizardshq.com/coding-classes-middle-school-students): Middle school Python, JavaScript, HTML/CSS classes with project-based learning
- [Coding Classes for High School Students | Ages 14-18](https://www.codewizardshq.com/coding-classes-high-school-students): High school Python, JavaScript, Java classes with internship and certification
- [Coding Classes for Ages 8-18 | Explore Our Programs](https://www.codewizardshq.com/coding-programs-for-kids): Main programs overview for Python, Java, HTML/CSS, JavaScript across all age groups

## Specialized Language Tracks

- [Python Language Track | Coding Classes for Ages 14-18 | Enroll today!](https://www.codewizardshq.com/python-language-track): Comprehensive Python track from beginner to advanced for teens ages 14-18
- [AP Computer Science Prep Track | Java Programming | Ages 14-18](https://www.codewizardshq.com/apcs): AP Computer Science A prep with Java I and II for high school exam preparation

## Summer Camps & Game Development

- [Summer Coding Camp 2026 | Trustpilot's #1 Summer Camp](https://www.codewizardshq.com/summer): Summer camp hub featuring Python, Java, Minecraft, Roblox, Fortnite, and AI
- [Virtual Coding Camp for Kids 8-18 | Trustpilot's #1 Summer Camp](https://www.codewizardshq.com/coding-camps): Summer camps overview with Minecraft, Roblox, Fortnite, and AI programs
- [Summer Coding Classes for Kids & Teens | CodeWizardsHQ](https://www.codewizardshq.com/summer/classes): Summer classes in Scratch, Python, Java, HTML across elementary to high school
- [Minecraft Coding Camp | Summer Camps | Ages 8-13](https://www.codewizardshq.com/coding-camps/minecraft-redstone-logic): 1-week Minecraft Redstone Logic camp teaching coding fundamentals via gates
- [Intro to Roblox Game Development | Coding Camp | Ages 8-13](https://www.codewizardshq.com/coding-camps/roblox-game-development): 1-week Roblox Studio and Lua coding camp for ages 8-13
- [Fortnite Game Development Coding Camp | Ages 8-18](https://www.codewizardshq.com/coding-camps/fortnite-game-development-with-unreal-editor): 1-week Fortnite UEFN game development camp for ages 8-18

## AI & Machine Learning Programs

- [AI Camp for Kids - CodeWizardsHQ](https://www.codewizardshq.com/coding-camps/ai): 2-day AI and machine learning camp for ages 8-18 with model training
- [AI and Machine Learning: The Basics - CodeWizardsHQ](https://www.codewizardshq.com/coding-camps/ai-and-machine-learning-the-basics): AI/ML beginner camp for ages 8-10 using Google's Teachable Machine
- [AI and Machine Learning Coding Camp | 2-Day Summer Camp](https://www.codewizardshq.com/coding-camps/ai-and-machine-learning-the-fundamentals): 2-day AI/ML camp for ages 11-13 with image recognition and web app building
- [AI and Machine Learning Coding Camp | 2-Day Summer Camp](https://www.codewizardshq.com/coding-camps/ai-and-machine-learning-the-foundation): 2-day AI/ML camp for ages 14-18 with Teachable Machine and image recognition

## High School Opportunities

- [High School Coding Internship Program - CodeWizardsHQ](https://www.codewizardshq.com/internship): Real-world full-stack development internship for high school students
